newsitem.title: USA: ELXSI sees 1996 results hurt by Abdow buy.
newsitem.headline: ELXSI sees 1996 results hurt by Abdow buy.

text.p: ELXSI Corp said Friday it expects 1996 earnings will be hurt by the July 1995 purchase of Abdow's, a chain of 16 restaurants in Massachusetts and Connecticut.
The company said it expects lower-than-expected earnings because declining sales hurt margins as the company waited to convert the restaurants.
ELXSI sought to convert about nine of the restaurants into Bickford's Restaurants. Two were sold or closed, and five still operate under the Abdow name, the company said.
"While the converted Abdow's are performing well, the remainder had very disappointed sales while they awaited conversion," the company said.
The company said it is accelerating its schedule for converting the remaining restaurants, which will result in more than $300,000 of conversion costs.
